resourceName: Chol Charoen Group Wastewater Treatment with Biogas System I (Kampangpet)
description: The project activity involves recovery of fugitive biogas from the wastewater released from tapioca starch processing plant. The recovered biogas is used in a boiler to generate heat for the starch drying process as well as used in gas engines to generate electricity. The produced electricity will be used to meet the power requirement of the starch processing plant and may later be supplied to national-owned grid in the future. After satisfying the above demands, surplus biogas, if any, is flared for safety purpose. The project has a total electrical generation capacity of less than 15 MWel and will generate emission reductions less than 60 ktCO2e per year.
